normalization: loss mean over each half; coherence is a ratio of squared Euclidean norms
split: deterministic prefix halves; no shuffle; drop one trailing sample if odd; undersized batches stay open
loss: Rp logistic softplus(-(real-fake)).mean() on critic parameters; penalty graph is separate
rate_rule: network=0.01+0.99*gain prior=0.05+0.95*gain; gain from coherence EMA after warmup
mix_rule: mix gain equals rate gain; K3P handover maps that gain to s and does not read applied LR
noise: unchanged host schedule; intermediate ablation; ring driver still passes noise_horizon 1200
budget_dependencies: host noise still receives a horizon (ring driver hardcodes 1200; transfer tasks pass their step count)
config network_lr_horizon_cap remains because the host requires it; phase_multipliers ignores the value
phase_multipliers still accepts step, total, anneal, and floors and does not use them
warmup 200 and the rise/fall EMA weights are estimator constants, not a training horizon
